name: RECOIL-v2
mechanism: Promote the state vector from a (length, status) pair to a genuine 3D (length, status, timing) triple. The mutation chooser now scores every probe jointly on all three axes: abs(len_delta) x status-grammar-shift x normalized timing spread (e.g. zscore of ms vs family baseline). Timing becomes a first-class discriminator, not an echo annotation.
what_it_does_previous_couldnt: RECOIL-v1 picks mutations purely on body-length and status; a blind boolean leg that leaks truth only through response latency (timing oracle) is invisible to it. The 3D state space lets a slow-vs-fast split be a landed primitive — the nozzle widens to timing-delimited boolean legs a length-only scanner structurally cannot see.
fireback: The box now answers in three dimensions. When sqli-b's oracle is only timing-visible, the operator first sees it as 'the tool hesitating' — variable latency — then the extracted flag rolls out. RECOIL literally takes longer to strike, and that time IS the aim.
containment: Timing is measured against the bundled fixture's own (len,status,ms) baseline only, an in-allowlist loopback target; no cross-host timing is ever compared. The canonicalizing allowlist resolver re-validates every destination before each probe.
kill_switch: --max-timing-reps flag caps timing probes per axis; a per-axis budget escape hatch terminates the timing leg. Evidence journal records every timing delta so the operator sees exactly which axis consumed budget.
novelty_angle: The RECOIL fireback thesis generalized: a response DELTA is multi-axial, so the learning signal becomes a vector, not a scalar. Static scanners are 1-axis; RECOIL-v1 is 2-axis; this is the first axis-promotion that changes which primitives are even detectable, not just survivable.
